summary: Five changes covering every gap and prerequisite carried from assess and analyze, with no gap left without a disposition. Two open questions analyze could not close are decided here because a spec cannot be executed while they are open: (1) mock agent, not a real LLM — a real LLM converts this into an inference-integration phase; (2) Vite dev-server middleware plugin, not a standalone Express/Hono/Fastify process — chosen on the same self-containment argument that disqualified openai-proxy in analyze, since a scaffolded app must stand up under `pnpm dev` alone. The middleware's dev-only limitation is called out as a required README task in p7-05 rather than left implicit.

decisions_made_at_spec.question: mock agent vs real LLM
decisions_made_at_spec.answer: MOCK — proves the transport and satisfies every verification criterion; a real LLM adds credential handling, streaming translation, and its own failure modes.

decisions_made_at_spec.question: Node hosting mechanism (carried UNRESOLVED out of analyze at its revision cap)
decisions_made_at_spec.answer: Vite dev-server middleware plugin. No second process, no extra runtime dependency, `pnpm dev` runs the whole demo. Consequence stated: dev-only, so p7-05 task 1.6 makes the README say so plainly.

warnings_from_adversarial_review: TOOLING DEFECT: build-review-packet.sh only supports the native-kbd backend — it looks for .kbd-orchestrator/changes/<id>/{spec.md,tasks.json,verification.md} and exits 2 for openspec projects. kbd-spec explicitly supports openspec, so the spec-stage vet cannot run via the normal path here. Packet was assembled manually and judged by a fresh-context subagent: weaker isolation than a gateway call, stated not hidden.

Cross-change coupling that no gate would have caught: p7-05 reads assets/scaffold/agui/ paths by name from p7-03 and p7-04. A rename in either would silently break p7-05. Both now declare the paths as a downstream contract — execute must not relocate them without updating p7-05 in the same commit.
package.json is shared between p7-03 and p7-04. The dependency edge makes it safe, but the two must not run in parallel worktrees.
p7-02 depends on a pre-1.0 package (@ag-ui/core@0.0.59) whose enum may move. Task 1.2 halts and escalates on mismatch rather than editing against a new reading.
